scope: Only FileTaskCapsuleStore._task_document opts in. Generic JSON, same-buffer SHA256, memory, state, session, artifacts, JSONL, transaction marker and every writer remain unchanged.
reason: Controlled ordinary Windows read handle blocked existing replacement through original retry policy; unlocked task.yaml identity discovery is a concrete supported concurrency opportunity. This is a compatibility proposal for that opportunity, not a cause diagnosis of execution16.
native_ownership: CreateFileW requests GENERIC_READ, shares READ|WRITE|DELETE, OPEN_EXISTING, NULL security attributes (non-inheritable).
Before successful open_osfhandle conversion own raw HANDLE; close it if conversion raises, surface CloseHandle failure.
After successful conversion own fd; close fd if fdopen raises.
After stream creation context closes stream/fd/native handle on read success or exception; no CloseHandle after ownership transfer.
security_bounds: Fresh existing link/junction ancestry guard before the one buffer read; no removed guard or path/model cache.
Strict existing decoder and dictionary validation; caller schema/id/run_id validation unchanged.
Windows ACLs still enforce GENERIC_READ; no write access, chmod, privilege, service or policy change.
No broad all-capsule locking, new lock order, checkpoint/approval/transaction changes, write retry/delay increase, durability or format change.
Atomic replacement may provide coherent old bytes to existing reader and new bytes to next reader; not a guarantee for in-place writers or an elimination of existing path TOCTOU.

instrumentation_limits.boundary: ReadProbe patches Path.open; native reads bypass this and prior io.open observation. Broad generic-reader replacement was rejected in this proposal to preserve current memory-record/graph accounting.
instrumentation_limits.restriction: No measured task-read reduction credit or claim of complete Path.open accounting after applying this opt-in. Before any workload can exercise this native task metadata path under ReadProbe, independent new observer/accounting validation is required. Protected benchmark source/assertions must not be edited or silently evolved.
instrumentation_limits.scope_not_proven_by_static_review: No claim every future memory workflow excludes task metadata; no benchmark invocation or proposed read observer exists.

prospective_tests_not_added_or_run: Windows barrier-controlled opt-in reader held during original atomic replacement: replacement succeeds within unchanged policy, held reader returns entire old JSON, subsequent reader entire new JSON; no mixed/partial object.
Generic read_json_object_with_sha256 remains byte/AST-identical; parse and hash same original one-read buffer regression stays.
Missing file, Unicode name, native access denied propagate appropriate OSError subclasses with filename; existing malformed UTF8/JSON/duplicate keys/schema/identity errors unchanged.
Fresh real symlink/junction guard rejection before native open, including parent links, unchanged external swap limitations.

Mocked conversion failure closes raw handle once; fdopen failure closes fd once; read failure and successful read close stream/fd once; CloseHandle failure surfaced rather than hidden; native repeated reads no leaked/inherited handles.
POSIX fallback is original Path.read_bytes; importing module on POSIX never requires msvcrt/WinDLL.
ReadProbe parity for existing memory workflows and explicit documentation of native task-read metric limitation, without modifying frozen benchmark or claiming bypass as reduction.

actual_evidence.original_fatal_cause: Unresolved. One execution diagnostic passed26checks but two real session/artifact replacement denials had no matching observed owned io.open readers; proposal does not address or explain these unmatched errors.
